title: Treatise on the Cranequin Draw
summary: Teaches a Senior to span a heavy prod with a geared cranequin and to keep the bow ready through a long exchange.

title: The Rolling Fire Handbook
summary: Teaches a Senior to loose in turns within a rank so some span while others fire and the stream of bolts never stops.

title: Handbook of the Bridled Prod
summary: Teaches a Senior to tune a bridled prod and keep its string true and to use qi on a stiff bow.

title: A Drill-Book for Pavise Fighters
summary: Teaches a Senior to fight from behind a standing shield board and to span in its cover and rise to loose.

title: Canon of Ranked Range Calls
summary: Teaches a Senior to judge and call ranges along a line and to loose to a fixed distance on command.

title: Workbook of the Stock Bash and Loose
summary: Teaches a Senior to strike with the stock at close range and to loose again so the bow serves both purposes.

title: A Plain Treatise on Penetrating Quarrels
summary: Teaches a Senior to choose and aim narrow-headed quarrels so a bolt finds the seams of hide and mail and plate.

title: Skirmish Reader for the Crossbow
summary: Teaches a Senior to move and halt and loose in broken ground and to reload on the run.

title: Handbook of Bolts for Bind and Hobble
summary: Teaches a Senior to loose cord-trailing bolts at legs and limbs to snare and trip a target without killing it.

title: Drill Sheets for the Heavy Prod
summary: Drill sheets that teach a Senior to span and hold and loose a stiff heavy prod with qi help and sound posture.
